# The Clear Stack

> AI consolidation consulting for mid-market companies (50–500 employees). We audit AI and SaaS stacks, eliminate redundant tools, and build Make.com automation that connects the rest. Typical engagement identifies $94K–$220K in annual savings. Based in the US.

## Services

- [What We Do](https://theclearstack.com/index.html): The Clear Stack Playbook ($49 PDF methodology), done-for-you implementation ($10K–$25K, 90-day delivery), retainers, Make.com template marketplace, and coaching cohort.
- [The 4C Framework](https://theclearstack.com/method.html): Our methodology — Catalog, Consolidate, Connect, Coach. Includes a stack-savings calculator.
- [Use Cases](https://theclearstack.com/usecases.html): Engagements for professional services, financial services, healthcare operations, manufacturing & logistics, and technology companies.
- [Contact](https://theclearstack.com/contact.html): Book a free 30-minute stack audit — no commitment.

## Lab (free tools)

- [Marketing Dashboard](https://theclearstack.com/lab/marketing-dashboard.html): Free drag-and-drop marketing tool. Answer a few questions about your business and generate a positioning line, a week of social media posts with image briefs, and SEO & AEO copy (page titles, meta descriptions, headlines, FAQs). No signup to start; data stays in the user's browser.
- [Lab index](https://theclearstack.com/lab/index.html): All free tools and experiments.
